extracted.intended_audience: patent practitioners and attorneys registered to practice before the USPTO; OED staff and regulatory/compliance counsel
extracted.subtask_description: A USPTO Final Order documenting stipulated facts, legal conclusions (disciplinary rule violations), and the agreed sanctions and compliance obligations for a registered patent attorney excluded on consent. Includes references to applicable 37 C.F.R. provisions and required filings/actions to effectuate the order and any reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.77(c) — Allowing applications to go abandoned without client consent
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent violated 37 C.F.R. § 10.77(c) by allowing applications to go abandoned without the consent of the clients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stipulated facts: in several cases applications became abandoned due to Respondent's failure to provide timely replies to USPTO office actions (¶4). This rule proscribes abandoning client matters without consent.

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(4) — Misrepresentations to clients and the USPTO about reviving applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent violated 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(4) by making misrepresentations to clients and the USPTO about having taken action to revive certain applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stipulated facts indicate Respondent informed clients and the USPTO that he would revive or had revived applications but did not take adequate steps (¶¶5-6).

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(5) — Misrepresentations to the USPTO during disciplinary investigation
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent violated 37 C.F.R. § 10.23(b)(5) by making misrepresentations to the USPTO during the course of a disciplinary investigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This addresses honesty in communications with the Office during investigations; the Final Order relies on the stipulated facts and admissions (¶9.c).

rubrics_metrics.name: 37 C.F.R. § 10.84(a) — Failure to represent clients zealously
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent violated 37 C.F.R. § 10.84(a) by not representing clients zealously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office found that Respondent's conduct (e.g., not timely replying and not reviving applications) constituted lack of zealous representation (¶9.d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exclusion on consent from practice before the USPTO
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent is excluded on consent from practicing patent, trademark, and other non-patent law before the Office beginning on the date of this Final Order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the principal sanction imposed by the Final Order (¶10.a).

rubrics_metrics.name: Limited recognition to wind up client matters (60 days)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent is granted limited recognition to practice before the Office beginning on the date of this Final Order and expiring sixty (60) days after the date of this Final Order for the limited purpose of winding up client business.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During this period Respondent must wind up client business and withdraw from employment in all pending proceedings in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 10.40 (¶10.b and ¶10.c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on accepting new clients during limited recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: During the period of limited recognition, Respondent shall not accept any new clients having business before the Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This restriction is explicit in the Final Order (¶10.d).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of Final Order and Notice in Official Gazette
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall publish this Final Order and shall publish a Notice of Exclusion on Consent in the Official Gazette describing respondent, registration number, rules violated, and statutory/regulatory authority.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The order specifies the exact notice text to be published and cites 35 U.S.C. § 32 and 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.26, 11.27, and 11.59 (¶10.e–f).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice to state bars and appropriate entities (37 C.F.R. § 11.59)
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director shall, in accordance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.59, give notice to the state bars of Colorado and Illinois and to appropriate employees of the Office and to interested departments, agencies, and courts that Respondent has been excluded on consent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a mandatory notification requirement to other authorities (¶10.g).

rubrics_metrics.name: Surrender client active USPTO case files within 60 days and file proof
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 60 days of the date of this Final Order, Respondent shall surrender each client's active USPTO case file(s) to each client or another practitioner designated by each client, and shall file proof thereof with the OED Director within the same 60-day period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a time‑certain, mandatory file-transfer obligation intended to protect clients' interests (¶10.h).

rubrics_metrics.name: Cooperate in good faith with successor practitioner at no charge
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent shall cooperate in good-faith with the practitioner to whom a file is surrendered in order to prevent the client's interests from being harmed as a result of the file transfer and shall do so at no charge to the client or practitioner.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cooperation includes assistance necessary to avoid prejudice to clients (¶10.i).

rubrics_metrics.name: Forward client communications and take no further legal action after limited recognition ends
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon expiration of the period of limited recognition, Respondent shall forward immediately any communication relating to a client matter that is addressed to Respondent and/or received by him for the client or the practitioner designated by the client, and shall take no other legal action in the matter, enter any appearance, or provide any legal advice concerning the matter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requirement is in accordance with 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.58(a) and (b)(5) and is intended to prevent unauthorized practice after limited recognition expires (¶10.j).

rubrics_metrics.name: Return unearned funds and property within 30 days and file proof
rubrics_metrics.description: Within 30 days of the date of this Final Order, Respondent shall return to any client having immediate or prospective business before the Office any unearned legal funds, including any unearned retainer fee, and any securities and property of the client, and shall file proof thereof with the OED Director no later than filing his petition for reinstatement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit monetary/property accounting and return obligation tied to potential reinstatement (¶10.k).

rubrics_metrics.name: Take steps to comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58(b)(1)(vi), (b)(4), and (b)(6) and file affidavit
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent shall promptly take steps to comply with the provisions of 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.58(b)(1)(vi), (b)(4), and (b)(6); and within 45 days of taking steps to comply, file with the OED Director an affidavit describing the precise nature of the steps taken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This imposes a duty to take corrective action and to attest under oath to the precise remedial steps taken (¶10.l).

rubrics_metrics.name: Upon expiration of limited recognition, comply with 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.58(b)(3) and (b)(5)
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon expiration of the period of limited recognition afforded by this Final Order, Respondent shall comply immediately with 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.58(b)(3) and (b)(5).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: References specific subsections of 11.58 that govern post-recognition responsibilities; the order makes compliance immediate upon expiration (¶10.m).

rubrics_metrics.name: General compliance with 37 C.F.R. § 11.58(a) and (e) as of the date of the Final Order
rubrics_metrics.description: Except as provided in paragraphs 10.b and 10.q above, Respondent shall comply with the provisions of 37 C.F.R. §§ 11.58(a) and (e) as of the date of this Final Order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This sets an effective date for broader compliance obligations under § 11.58; note paragraph reference '10.q' appears in the text (¶10.n).

rubrics_metrics.name: Reinstatement petition requirements under 37 C.F.R. § 11.60
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon filing a petition for reinstatement under 37 C.F.R. § 11.60, Respondent shall submit proof of compliance with §§ 11.58(b)(2), (b)(3), (b)(4), (b)(5), (b)(6), and 11.58(f) with the OED Director and otherwise comply with 37 C.F.R. § 11.60.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reinstatement is conditioned on documented compliance with multiple subsections of § 11.58 and procedural compliance with § 11.60 (¶10.o).

rubrics_metrics.name: Settlement agreement procedural requirements (37 C.F.R. §§ 11.26, 11.27)
rubrics_metrics.description: The proposed settlement agreement satisfies the requirements of 37 C.F.R. § 11.26 and the parties submitted an affidavit executed by Respondent pursuant to 37 C.F.R. § 11.27.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Settlement agreements resolving disciplinary action must comply with § 11.26; an affidavit under § 11.27 is part of the settlement submission (Introductory paragraphs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Allocation of costs — each party bears own costs
rubrics_metrics.description: The OED Director and Respondent shall each bear their own costs incurred to date and in carrying out the terms of this agreement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No award of costs between the parties under this Final Order (¶10.p).
